flows.title: Create and publish a document
steps: In Sanity Studio, select the + icon in the top navigation and choose a content type (or navigate to the content type in the sidebar and click + in its document list).
Complete all required fields, marked with asterisks.
Select Publish in the lower right to publish the document.

flows.title: Create a task in Studio
steps: Open your tasks inbox from the checkmark icon in the top-right of the Studio navbar.
Click + New task to create a new task.
Give the task a due date and assign it to the person who should handle it (or @mention a Studio user); they'll get a notification.
Optionally attach the task to a target document so it's easy to find in context.
Once it's handled, resolve the task from the list to check it off.

flows.title: Search and filter content
steps: Use the global search bar to search across all content types by keyword, document title, or content snippet.
Apply filters to narrow results by document type, creation or edit date, or any field in your content model.
In any document list, open the pane menu (⋮) to sort by title, created date, or last edited, and to switch between Compact and Detailed views.
